Package com.sbancuz.offscreen.api.script

package com.sbancuz.offscreen.api.script
Shared window, file, panel, animation and media facades for Java, Kotlin, Scala, Groovy and ZenScript. The optional ZenScript integration registers these types without adding a scripting dependency to this package.
